name: Alcove columbine
desc: Alcove columbine (Aquilegia micrantha): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 18 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Aquilegia micrantha, the Mancos columbine or Bluff City columbine, is a perennial species of flowering plant in the family Ranunculaceae. It is native to Utah, Colorado, and Arizona.
